title: El Barro de Coyotepec, MEXI TV
comment: barro-coyotepec (MEXITV): patio-taller de barro negro en San Bartolo Coyotepec, Oaxaca. Caras comunes, no famosas; los cuatro se distinguen a simple vista.

chars.FIDELA_PEDRO: Zapotec Mexican woman from Oaxaca, black clay potter, 72 years old, small, dark-brown wrinkled skin, grey hair in two braids with dark ribbons, a dark-blue embroidered huipil, a long dark skirt, a grey rebozo, sandals, clay on her hands, her hands empty.
chars.ROGELIO_PEDRO: Zapotec Mexican man from Oaxaca, 30 years old, brown skin, short black hair, a light stubble, a plain grey t-shirt, a clay-stained canvas apron, jeans, sandals, his hands empty.
chars.EFREN_MATUS: Mexican man, 36 years old, light-brown skin, gelled black hair, rectangular glasses, a thin mustache, a light-blue dress shirt with a dark tie, grey trousers, black shoes, holding a black folder.
chars.MATIAS_LUIS: Mexican businessman from Oaxaca, 58 years old, tall, brown skin, short grey hair, a neat grey beard, a cream guayabera, cream trousers, brown loafers, a gold watch, holding dark sunglasses.

locs.LOC_TALLERBARRO: Patio of a family black clay pottery workshop in San Bartolo Coyotepec, Oaxaca, in the afternoon: shelves full of shiny black clay pots and jars, an underground brick kiln with smoke, a potter's work area with wet clay, adobe walls, agave plants, a dirt road beyond a low gate, warm light, no readable text, no signs, no logos, no people.
